title: Stuck queue
summary: Since early afternoon, no order confirmation email has gone out, for anyone.
alert: [FIRING] ConfirmationsStuck: no order confirmation sent for 10 minutes

choices.label: The worker is stuck on one message it can never send, retrying it forever, and every message behind it waits
The worker crashed and doesn't restart
The worker is too slow again

questions.prompt: Why can't that one message be sent?

choices.label: Its customer's email address is invalid, and MailWave refuses it

questions.prompt: What should the worker do with a message it can't process?

choices.label: Set it aside, with the reason, where someone can fix and replay it, and move on
Drop it and log the error
Stop the worker, so that someone notices
Skip to the end of the partition

slos.label: Confirmation email delay (p95)
slos.query: SELECT coalesce(round(1000 * percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM coalesce(confirmation_sent_at, $end) - created_at))), 0) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= $start AND created_at < $end - interval '10 seconds'
